scope: Local production build; browser automation in Chromium, not deployed production

methods.keyboard: Native browser key presses for Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, arrow keys and Escape, except Escape dispatched as a KeyboardEvent in the simulated reduced-motion scenario.
methods.history: Native history.back()/history.forward(); popstate and animation state recorded.
methods.accessibility: Chromium accessibility tree and DOM/focus assertions. Header, main, footer and navigation absent from the exposed accessibility tree while the dialog is open.
methods.reducedMotion: Simulated by overriding MediaQueryList.matches for the reduced-motion queries; verified zero animation durations. Not an operating-system setting or physical-device test.
methods.originalInert: A test aside already had inert=true before opening; it remained inert after closing.

screenReaderAcceptance.reason: NVDA is not available in this environment. The accessibility-tree checks do not replace a real screenreader test.
remainingChecks: In DE and EN, confirm that opening by mouse and Enter announces the localized modal dialog.
Use browse mode to confirm header, main content and footer are inaccessible while the dialog is open.
Verify Tab and Shift+Tab, image changes, Escape and focus return.
Repeat Back/Forward during transitions and reduced motion.
